case.pattern_description: Threshold structuring on a compromised card: 3 online purchases ($499.98, $499.95, $499.91) placed within about an hour, each kept just under $500, the level at which authorisation checks tighten. It affects cardholders whose card numbers are already compromised and matches five closed cases the bank confirmed but could not map to a known typology; the agent found it by scanning the card's window for clusters of same-band amounts.

sar.narrative: Customer C05560, holder of card C05560-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-06 11:16 and 2016-12-06 11:23, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,499.84 were made on the card online from device profile 'rv:11.0 |  | ie 11.0 for desktop | ': $499.98 (3518540, 2016-12-06 11:16), $499.95 (3518547, 2016-12-06 11:21), $499.91 (3518549, 2016-12-06 11:23). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: 3 online purchases within 7 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($499.98, $499.95, $499.91; total $1,499.84). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2476, CC-0606, CC-3624. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
